en.title: Maximum Aggregate Temperature Change over All Days
en.description:
The aggregate temperature change of day i is the larger of the prefix sum from day 1 to day i and the suffix sum from day i to the last day; both parts include day i. Return the maximum aggregate temperature change over all days; an empty prefix or suffix is not allowed.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n temperature changes. 1≤n≤100000, −10^9≤change≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 9, 5 and −5; in the last example you cannot choose an empty segment to get 0.
hints: First compute the total, then maintain the prefix day by day. The current suffix equals the total minus the previous prefix; compare both the current prefix and the suffix.
